kv1.9:1.3: sabbe dhammā - sati, satindriyaṃ, satibalaṃ, sammāsatisatimbojjhaṅgo, ekāyanamaggo khayagāmī bodhagāmī apacayagāmī anāsavā asaññojaniyā aganthanīyā anoghanīyā ayoganīyā anīvaraṇiyā aparāmaṭṭhā anupādāniyā, asaṅkilesikā? sabbedhammā - buddhānussati, dhammānussati, saṅghānussati, sīlānussati, cāgānussati, devatānussati, ānāpānasati, maraṇānussati, kāyagatāsati, upasamānussatī’ti?
kv1.9:2.7: cakkhāyatanaṃ - sati, satindriyaṃ, satibalaṃ, sammāsati, satisambejjhaṅgo, ekāyanamaggo khayagāmī bodhagāmī apacayagāmī anāsavaṃ asaññojaniyaṃ …pe… asaṅkilesikaṃ? cakkhāyatanaṃ - buddhānussati, dhammānussati, saṅghānussati, sīlānussati cāgānussati, devatānussati, ānāpānasati maraṇānussati, kāyagatāsati, upasamānussatī’ti?
kv1.9:4.3: sati satipaṭṭhānā sā ca na satī’ti.
kv1.9:4.14: sati satipaṭṭhānā, sā ca na satī’ti.
kv1.9:5.4: nanu sabbe dhamme ārabbha sati santiṭṭhatī’ti.
kv1.9:5.6: hañci sabbe dhamme ārabbha sati santiṭṭhati, tena vata re vattabbe
kv1.9:6.1: “sabbaṃ dhammaṃ ārabbha sati santiṭṭhatī”ti sabbe dhammā satipaṭṭhānā’ti.
kv1.9:6.3: sabbaṃ dhammaṃ ārabbha phasso santiṭṭhatī’ti. sabbe dhammā phassapaṭṭhānā’ti.
kv1.9:7.1: sabbaṃ dhammaṃ ārabbha sati santiṭṭhatī’ti sabbe dhammā satipaṭṭhānā’ti.
kv1.9:8.3: sabbe sattā upaṭṭhitasatino satiyā samannāgatā satiyā samāhitā
kv1.9:9.4: “amatante bhikkhave na paribhuñjanti ye kāyagataṃsatiṃ na paribhuñjanti,
kv1.9:9.5: amatante bhikkhave paribhuñjanti ye kāyagataṃ satiṃ paribhuñjantī’ti”
kv1.9:9.8: sabbe sattā kāyagataṃ satiṃ paribhuñjanti, paṭilabhanti, āsevanti bhāventi bahulīkarontīti.
kv1.9:10.4: “ekāyano ayaṃ bhikkhave maggo sattānaṃ visuddhiyā sokapariddavānaṃ samatikkamāya dukkhadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamāya ñāyassa adhigamāya nibbānassa sacchikiriyāya yadidaṃ cattāro satipaṭṭhānā’ti”
kv1.9:11.4: “rañño bhikkhave cakkavattissa pātubhāvā sattannaṃ ratanānaṃ pātubhāvo hoti.
kv1.9:11.6: cakkaratanassa pātubhāvo hoti, hatthiratanassa pātubhāvo hoti, assaratanassa …pe…
kv1.9:11.11: rañño bhikkhave cakkavattissa pātubhāvā imesaṃ sattannaṃ ratanānaṃ pātubhāvo hoti.
kv1.9:12.1: tathāgatassa bhikkhave pātubhāvā arahato sammāsambuddhassa sattannaṃ bojjhaṅgaratanānaṃ pātubhāvo hoti.
kv1.9:12.3: satisambojjhaṅgaratanassa pātubhāvo hoti, dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgaratanassa pātubhāvo hoti, viriyasambojjhaṅgaratanassa pātubhāvo hoti, pītisambojjhaṅgaratanassa pātubhāvo hoti, passaddhisambojjhaṅgaratanassa pātubhāvo hoti, samādhisambojjhaṅgaratanassa pātubhāvo hoti, upekkhāsambojjhaṅgaratanassa pātubhāvo hoti,
kv1.9:12.4: tathāgatassa bhikkhave pātubhāvā arahato sammāsambuddhassa imesaṃ sattannaṃ bojjhaṅgaratanānaṃ pātubhāvo hoti”ti
kv1.9:12.7: tathāgatassa pātubhāvā arahato sammāsambuddhassa sabbe dhammā satisambojjhaṅgaratanā’va hontī’ti.
